drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input_schema and the choose, ask and order steps); read from the row's words, no test runs it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:print-and-deliver for my file menu-poster.pdf: 40 copies at 11 x 17 in, I am at 100 Example Street and need them on my way to 200 Example Avenue by Friday at 5 PM."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Put the file in your files and decide the finished size, the number of copies, where you start (near), the place you need the prints (on_the_way_to) and the deadline (by).
2. Say "Run workflow:print-and-deliver" with those values. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps choose, ask, order.
3. At choose, a small job (Letter or A4, a few copies) goes to your own printer; any other size goes to the print shop nearest your route, with its price read from the shop's own print page.
4. At ask, one row lands on your Waiting on you list with what is printed, where, ready when and the price; nothing is ordered until you tap yes (a yes you gave before skips the tap).

5. At order, the AI orders through the shop account in your name and gives you route buttons from where you start, through the shop, to where you need the prints. If an account or card blocks it, it names which.
